title: pinea esculenta
intro: Pinea esculenta, commonly known as the Indian gooseberry, is a plant species that belongs to the family Sapindaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to boost the immune system, protect against chronic diseases, and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Pinea esculenta include its ability to regulate blood sugar levels, reduce cholesterol and triglyceride levels, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Pinea esculenta include ascorbic acid, flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
